attributes.description: Objects created by the security logs demo

attributes.title: Security logs demo
attributes.description: Raw event tabs (failed logons, sudo, PowerShell, new processes) and aggregation tabs (event volume by OS, brute force, spray then success), one ES|QL query per tab

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON:
{"query": {"esql": "FROM logs-*
| WHERE event.code == "4625" OR (event.dataset == "system.auth" AND event.outcome == "failure")
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, host.os.type, user.name, source.ip, event.code, message
| LIMIT 500"}, "filter": []}

{"query": {"esql": "FROM logs-*
| WHERE event.dataset == "system.auth" AND process.name == "sudo"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, user.name, process.name, message
| LIMIT 500"}, "filter": []}

{"query": {"esql": "FROM logs-*
| WHERE event.code == "4104" OR event.dataset IN ("windows.powershell_operational", "windows.powershell")
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, user.name, event.code, powershell.file.script_block_text, message
| LIMIT 500"}, "filter": []}

{"query": {"esql": "FROM logs-*
| WHERE (event.dataset == "windows.sysmon_operational" AND event.code == "1") OR (event.dataset == "auditd_manager.auditd" AND auditd.data.syscall == "execve")
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, host.os.type, user.name, process.name, process.command_line, process.parent.name
| LIMIT 500"}, "filter": []}
{"query": {"esql": "FROM logs-*\n| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day), host.os.type\n| SORT day"}, "filter": []}

{"query": {"esql": "FROM logs-*
| WHERE event.code == "4625" OR (event.dataset == "system.auth" AND event.outcome == "failure")
| STATS failures = COUNT(*) BY source.ip, window = BUCKET(@timestamp, 5 minutes)
| WHERE failures > 10
| SORT failures DESC
| LIMIT 50"}, "filter": []}

{"query": {"esql": "FROM logs-*
| WHERE source.ip IS NOT NULL
    AND (event.code IN ("4624", "4625")
         OR (event.dataset == "system.auth" AND event.outcome IN ("success", "failure")))
| EVAL failed = CASE(event.outcome == "failure", 1, 0),
       ok     = CASE(event.outcome == "success", 1, 0)
| STATS failures = SUM(failed),
        successes = SUM(ok),
        users_tried = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.name),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
  BY source.ip
| WHERE failures > 20 AND successes > 0
| SORT failures DESC"}, "filter": []}
